title: The Penny Lost $86 Million A Year
hook: America kept minting a coin that destroyed value every time.
closing: The penny survived centuries, but its production bill finally outweighed its place in your pocket.
question: Would you miss the penny?

segments.say: Making pennies lost $86 million a year. Ending production finally stops that recurring bill.
The penny lasted 232 years. Its history delayed a decision that the cost had already made obvious.
A nickel costs 13.78 cents to make. Ending the penny does not solve America's money-losing coin problem.
